outcome: Exerting an untapped or already exerted permanent works, and multiple exert effects all expire at the same untap step.
An object not on the battlefield cannot be exerted.
Exerting as the creature attacks is an optional attack cost, and its linked when-you-do trigger fires only if the creature was exerted.
